DIRECTOR: Hello, I'm Anna Duma, the director of the shelter
FIRST_DIV_DIRECTOR: Every day we work to create a real shelter for animals that saves lives, helps find safe and the best conditions for each animal, and gives them a chance for a happy future in loving families.
SECOND_DIV_DIRECTOR: - is the main condition of a humane and good society. That's why creating conditions for rescue and care for tails - is the main mission of "Kindness". This is our daily motivation and inspiration, our contribution to a better future.
VOLUNTEER: Hello, I'm Alla Shop, the main curator of adoption
FIRST_DIV_VOLUNTEER: Every day I take care of it so that each rescued animal receives not only care and warmth, but also finds a safe home and a loving family. For me, the most important thing is to give a chance to an animal that has endured pain or indifference to feel trust in people again.
SECOND_DIV_VOLUNTEER: - is to find the best conditions and responsible owners so that our wards receive genuine care and have a happy future.
THIRD_DIV_VOLUNTEER: This is my daily mission and contribution to a better future for those who cannot speak for themselves but desperately need love and protection.
VET: Hello, I'm Ivan Dyak, the veterinarian at the shelter
FIRST_DIV_VET: My daily work is to take care of the health of rescued animals. I deal with treatment, rehabilitation, sterilization, and many other procedures so that each animal has a chance for a long and happy life.
SECOND_DIV_VET: - is not only to heal, but also to prepare animals for a new stage of life in loving families.
THIRD_DIV_VET: This is my mission, my daily call, and the greatest reward - to see how once weak and abandoned animals become healthy, strong, and happy.
